name: coach
description: A weekly coach for how you use Claude Code: one habit at a time from your own sessions, tips at your level, CLAUDE.md lines and skills worth making, and your progress over the weeks

excludeProjects.title: Projects to leave out
excludeProjects.description: Comma-separated folder paths coach never reads, such as private client work

storeExcerpts.title: Keep prompt excerpts
storeExcerpts.description: Keep short, scrubbed cuts of your prompts as evidence. Off also turns off the CLAUDE.md lines and skill templates made from your own words

contextThresholdK.title: Oversized session (thousands of tokens)
contextThresholdK.description: A session whose context passes this many thousand tokens counts as oversized

weekStartsOn.title: Week starts on
weekStartsOn.description: The day each weekly report starts

promptGrading.title: Grade prompts with a model
promptGrading.description: Once a week, send a sample of up to 20 opening prompts to Anthropic to be scored and one rewritten. Costs about a cent a week with Haiku

gradingCapUsd.title: Grading cap (USD a week)
gradingCapUsd.description: Skip a week's grading when its estimate is over this

liveHints.title: Live hints
liveHints.description: Short hints at the moment they apply, at most one every 30 minutes and three a day
